scope: Additive Frozen Arrow L1-27 audit of post-September-2024 slow values, hit timing and target interactions.
game_version: Official 2024-02 launch, dated 2024-08 announcement of September balance change, claimed client build 18.600.3 for 2026 DPS table, pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: The Dragon Festival is Here!
facts: Frozen Arrow is Epic passive Archer Queen Equipment whose arrows slow targets when hit and give Hero DPS.
Supercell published L1-27 launch slow percentages, durations and DPS bonuses; launch slow was 30-75 percent and duration 0.75-3.00 seconds.
sources.limitations: The launch slow percentage was subsequently changed. The article gives no target-class eligibility, impact phase, cadence formula, stacking or immunity rule.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes - September 2024
facts: The table changes slow percentages to 25,30,35,37,40,45,50,55,60,65 percent for successive level bands 1-2,3-5,6-8,9-11,12-14,15-17,18-20,21-23,24-26,27.
The new 2024 percentage bands match all 27 fields in the pinned raw payload.
sources.limitations: The article predates TH18 and does not establish September 2026 continuity, slow duration or exact attack-cadence application.

sources.title: Frozen Arrow — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The public L1-27 Queen DPS and ore-cost table matches the pinned payload, including L27 DPS bonus 168.
sources.limitations: The public table omits slow percentage, duration and hit-timing fields.

sources.title: Pinned Frozen Arrow Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned 27 rows preserve slowDown, slowDownDuration and Queen dpsIncrease. Slow percentages match the dated September 2024 post-nerf table and durations match the official launch table.
sources.limitations: Neither historical agreement proves unchanged 2026 slow values or projectile impact and expiry phase.

observations.note: Post-2024 slow series matches dated balance announcement; duration agrees with official launch. Current effect continuity remains unverified.

derivations.result: Treat official 2024 launch percentages as historical and retain the post-nerf raw series as historical data-only
derivations.method: Compare each official launch slow band to dated post-September-2024 band and all 27 pinned raw rows; no current 2026 effect table was found.

derivations.result: Retain DPS and upgrade cost as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check dated claimed-build public table against pinned normalized rows; no stat application order is inferred.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the official 2024 launch slow percentages as current
rejected_inferences.reason: The dated September 2024 balance table and pinned payload show lower slow percentages at every level.

rejected_inferences.rule: Infer that slowDown reduces movement and attack cadence by the same percentage
rejected_inferences.reason: The source calls it slow but does not publish which simulation quantities it modifies or their rounding.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply slow on projectile launch before the target is hit
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell states targets slow when hit, while current Queen projectile speed and impact phase are unresolved.

rejected_inferences.rule: Refresh or stack slow on each successive Queen hit
rejected_inferences.reason: Reapplication, stacking, maximum slow and immunity are not documented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Expire slow after a fixed number of 10 ms ticks beginning with impact
rejected_inferences.reason: The source gives duration values but not impact, first-active or expiry phase.

items: current-build slow percentage and duration continuity
target classes including Buildings, Walls, defensive Heroes, Pets and spawned units
whether movement, attack cadence or other timers are slowed and integer rounding
Queen projectile launch/impact and slow start/end tick order
refresh, stacking, immunity and overlapping freeze/poison/Rage behavior
Queen DPS bonus staging and interaction with Giant Arrow, Invisibility Vial and Magic Mirror
Viewer slow overlay, snapshot, replay and RL loadout contract

conclusion: Frozen Arrow L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Its passive Queen hit slow and launch duration are official; all 27 post-2024 percentages match a dated balance table and pinned payload, but current effect continuity and deterministic slow/impact tick rules remain unresolved.
